name: OGImg Covers
author: mar4elo06

sections.description:
OGImg Covers adds an “OGImg Covers — post cover” box to the post editor. The title, excerpt and site name are filled in from the post, you pick a style, accent color, badge and format — and the cover becomes the post’s og:image and twitter:image. Links shared in Telegram, VK, X, LinkedIn, Facebook and messengers get a proper preview card.

Features

  • 32 styles — the same as in the online editor at og-studio.online; holiday styles (Halloween, Black Friday, New Year) appear on their dates.
  • Photo styles: “Photo background” and “Product & price” use the post’s featured image.
  • Live preview right in the post editor.
  • Short image links like og-studio.online/img/Ab3xKp9f instead of long URLs.
  • Covers for existing posts in one click: Tools → OGImg Covers.
  • Default style for new posts: Settings → OGImg Covers.
  • [ogimg_covers_cover] shortcode to place the cover inside the post.
  • Works with Yoast SEO (wpseo_opengraph_image filter).
  • Pro key (for og-studio.online Pro subscribers): covers without the og-studio.online watermark.

The plugin does not create database tables and stores no images on your hosting: settings are kept in post meta and one option.

На русском. Плагин OGImg Covers делает обложку записи из заголовка: 32 шаблона (в «Фото-фоне» и «Товаре и цене» — «Изображение записи»), живое превью, автоматический og:image и twitter:image, обложки для старых записей одной кнопкой, ключ Про — без водяного знака. Подробно: https://og-studio.online/wp-plugin

External services

This plugin relies on the OG Studio service at og-studio.online (https://og-studio.online) to draw the cover images. Without it the plugin cannot produce images.

  • Rendering — the cover image is requested from https://og-studio.online/api/og/render.png (in the editor preview) and, on the public site, by visitors’ browsers and social network crawlers via the image link in og:image. Sent: the cover title, subtitle, brand text, style, accent color, badge and format; for the “Photo background” and “Product & price” styles also the public https URL of the post’s featured image, which the service downloads to draw the cover.
  • Short links — when a post with an enabled cover is saved (or during bulk generation for existing posts), the same cover parameters are sent to https://og-studio.online/api/og/shorten, which returns a short link https://og-studio.online/img/…. If a Pro key is set in the plugin settings, the key is sent too (server to server; it never appears on your pages).
  • Key check — when the settings page is opened with a Pro key filled in, the key is sent to https://og-studio.online/api/og/key-check to show its status.

No other data about your site, visitors or users is sent.

Terms of use: https://og-studio.online/legal
Privacy policy: https://og-studio.online/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Plugins → Add New → search “OGImg Covers”, or upload the zip and activate.
  2. Open any post — the “OGImg Covers — post cover” box is below the editor, fields are already filled in.
  3. Choose a style, tick “og:image” and update the post.
  4. Optional: Settings → OGImg Covers — default style and Pro key; Tools → OGImg Covers — covers for existing posts.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

Yes. Covers have a small og-studio.online label in the corner; og-studio.online Pro subscribers can remove it with a Pro key.

What happens with my existing posts?

Nothing until you run Tools → OGImg Covers. It creates covers only for published posts that have no OGImg Covers cover yet; posts you configured by hand are not touched.

Does it work with Yoast SEO / Rank Math?

With Yoast SEO the cover replaces Yoast’s og:image when enabled for the post. With other SEO plugins both tags may be printed; social networks use the first one.

What if og-studio.online is unavailable?

Already shared previews keep working from social network caches; new previews appear once the service is back. The plugin falls back to the full image link if a short link cannot be created.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Plugin renamed to OGImg Covers (new slug ogimg-covers); settings and per-post data are migrated automatically.
  • The old [og_studio_cover] shortcode keeps working.

1.4.0

  • New “Photo background” style: the post’s featured image as the cover background with a dark overlay.
  • “Product & price” shows the featured image in the product card.
  • The featured image must be an https URL; without one the cover is drawn without a photo.
  • With a Pro key the service keeps its own copy of the photo for the short link.
  • List style: up to 6 items.

1.3.0

  • 8 new task styles: blog article, webinar / event, quote, big number, product & price, job, podcast episode, list of 3 (31 styles in total).

1.2.0

  • Styles synced with the online editor (23 styles, editor names); holiday styles open only on their dates.
  • Settings page: default style, “enable for new posts”, Pro key.
  • Bulk covers for existing posts (Tools → OGImg Covers).
  • Pro key: short links without the watermark.
  • Scripts and styles are enqueued properly; uninstall cleans up.

1.1.0

  • Short image links og-studio.online/img/…

1.0.0

  • First release.
